title: Synthesis and biological evaluation of Cu(II) Aroyl-Hydrazone Schiff Base complexes with anticancer activity against breast cancer cells.
authors: Thatcher, R Margrate; Manojkumar, Y; Ramasamy, Rohith; Akturk, Buse; Dalbayrak, Basak; Solomon, Rajadurai Vijay; Arisan, Elif Damla; Dhayabaran, V Violet
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Cu(II)席夫碱配合物与CT-DNA的结合及抗癌活性，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作和分子动力学模拟，但核心是金属配合物药物设计，非TF-DNA转录结合体系，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: Two novel Cu(II) Schiff base complexes were synthesized using aroyl-hydrazone ligands containing pyrrole (Complex 1) and furan (Complex 2) moieties and characterized through FTIR, UV-Vis, EPR, ESI-MS, and NMR spectroscopy, supported by DFT calculations. Spectroscopic and computational analyses confirmed square-planar geometry with coordination via azomethine nitrogen and phenolic oxygen atoms. Binding interactions with bovine serum albumin (BSA) and calf thymus DNA (CT-DNA) were investigated using UV-Vis and fluorescence spectroscopy, revealing stronger affinity for Complex 1 (K(b) = 8.52 x 10(5) M(-1)) compared to Complex 2 (K(b) = 1.06 x 10(4) M(-1)). Molecular docking and 100 ns molecular dynamics simulations indicating the stable binding conformations. Cytotoxicity studies against human breast cancer cell lines (MDA-MB-231 and MCF-7) showed that Complex 2 exhibited higher potency (IC(5)(0) = 26.91 muM and 41.30 muM, respectively) than Complex 1. ROS and DAPI staining assays demonstrated apoptosis induction by Complex 2 through redox modulation and sub-G1 cell cycle arrest, suggesting a ligand-driven, partially DNA-independent mechanism. This suggests a non-canonical behaviour of action where ligand-driven redox modulation, rather than DNA intercalation, triggers cell death. These findings highlight the significant role of heterocyclic substitution (pyrrole vs. furan) in modulating the biological activity of Cu(II) Schiff base complexes and underscore their potential as redox-active anticancer agents.
abstract_zh: 利用含吡咯（Complex 1）和呋喃（Complex 2）部分的芳酰腙配体合成了两种新型Cu(II)席夫碱配合物，并通过FTIR、UV-Vis、EPR、ESI-MS和NMR光谱进行表征，辅以DFT计算。光谱和计算分析确认了方形平面几何构型，配位通过偶氮甲碱氮原子和酚氧原子实现。利用UV-Vis和荧光光谱研究了与牛血清白蛋白（BSA）和小牛胸腺DNA（CT-DNA）的结合相互作用，结果显示Complex 1（K(b) = 8.52 x 10(5) M(-1)）比Complex 2（K(b) = 1.06 x 10(4) M(-1)）具有更强的亲和力。分子对接和100 ns分子动力学模拟表明其具有稳定的结合构象。对人乳腺癌细胞系（MDA-MB-231和MCF-7）的细胞毒性研究表明，Complex 2比Complex 1表现出更高的效力（IC(5)(0) = 26.91 μM和41.30 μM，分别对应）。ROS和DAPI染色实验证明，Complex 2通过氧化还原调节和sub-G1细胞周期阻滞诱导细胞凋亡，提示其作用机制为配体驱动、部分不依赖DNA的途径。这表明其具有非经典行为，即配体驱动的氧化还原调节而非DNA嵌入触发细胞死亡。这些发现强调了杂环取代（吡咯与呋喃）在调节Cu(II)席夫碱配合物生物活性中的重要作用，并凸显了其作为氧化还原活性抗癌剂的潜力。
